responsibility: Client-side connection management for the experimental C++ modules mapper protocol. It opens mapper connections from command-line specifications (pipes, sockets, subprocesses, files, or in-process resolver/server), performs the initial handshake and repository discovery, tracks mapper flags and signal handling, and shuts down external or in-process mapper endpoints cleanly for the C++ modules subsystem.
same_name_distinction: Implements module mapper client behavior: parsing mapper connection specifications, opening pipes/sockets/subprocess or in-process resolvers, performing the Cody handshake, recording flags, and closing endpoints. Unlike mapper-client.h, it is the operational connection-management code, not just the wrapper class declaration.
